issues: General fortune and misery are broad categories with no measured outcomes, independent observations, base rates, decision thresholds or calibration in the source.
The phrase 3–4 dignified planets needs a frozen exact essential-dignity scheme and a defined chart/house algorithm before any meaningful test.
Mutual reception and debilitated house rules contain alternatives; avoid unregistered and retrospective selection of the most flattering chart configuration.
The author says positive natal configurations can be delayed; this can rescue failed timeless forecasts unless acceptable time windows and rejection rules are registered.

Directions of five Hylegical places and promittor contacts require precisely predeclared computations and historical-calendar assumptions; no explicit quantitative forecasting precision is demonstrated by this passage.
Use an independent cohort, exact event-date sources, blind targets, untouched held-out cases and meaningful non-astrological age/region/social controls to evaluate any future claims.
Happiness, esteem, 'misery', social class, calamity and status are different constructs; do not code them as one undifferentiated success score.
The Saturn/Mars/South Node/Mercury signification glyph grouping and conjunction/operator scope on page552 require another first-edition specialist audit before deterministic implementation.
The author's attribution of calamity cause from malefic house and time from directions is not proof of an independently foretold cause/date.
The unnumbered second-house wealth section begins mid original PDF586, followed by printed CXIIII wealth chapter on PDF587; do not skip either by following only Roman numbered chapters.
Original 1647 pages are preserved as image witnesses and clauses paraphrased; no full diplomatic transcription is claimed.
Historical astrology cannot be the basis for medical, legal, financial or personal safety judgments from these untested claims.
